event_summary: A green sheet between two scissor-like tools bends, develops a central separation, and ends as two separate green pieces on a tabletop.
raw_event_description: At the start, a bright green rectangular sheet lies mostly flat on a wooden tabletop, spanning between a black-and-blue handled tool on the left and a similar tool on the right. For several frames the sheet remains continuous and nearly still. A visible discontinuity then appears near the middle of the sheet, and the sheet bends upward and twists into two portions. The opening widens until the two green portions are visibly separate. After separation, the left portion tilts and settles on the left side of the table, while the right portion moves and settles on the right side. The two handled tools remain at opposite sides of the scene with little visible change.

reasons: The green sheet, both handled tools, and tabletop are visible.
The sheet appears continuous before the visible separation begins.
